As Micron Technology (MU) Stock Rose, Holder Parnassus Investments Cut by $45.10 Million Its Holding; Suvretta Capital Management Increases Stake in F M C (FMC)
May 21, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Parnassus Investments decreased its stake in Micron Technology Inc. (MU) by 22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parnassus Investments sold 1.10M shares as the company’s stock rose 18.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.90M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $160.37 million, down from 5.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parnassus Investments who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $61.92B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.39% or $1.31 during the last trading session, reaching $53.39. About 43.40 million shares traded. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has risen 82.20% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 70.65% the S&P500.
Aaron Cowen increased its stake in F M C Corp (FMC) by 4.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suvretta Capital Management Llc bought 119,173 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.14% with the market. The hedge fund run by Aaron Cowen held 2.70 million shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $255.41M, up from 2.58M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suvretta Capital Management Llc who had been investing in F M C Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.31B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $0.89 during the last trading session, reaching $91.51. About 835,935 shares traded. FMC Corporation (NYSE:FMC) has risen 22.51% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.96% the S&P500.

Analysts await Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) to report earnings on July, 5. They expect $2.81 EPS, up 100.71% or $1.41 from last year’s $1.4 per share. MU’s profit will be $3.26 billion for 4.75 P/E if the $2.81 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.80 actual EPS reported by Micron Technology, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 0.36% EPS growth.

(NYSE:XYL) by 48,919 shares to 6.06 million shares, valued at $413.52M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Novartis Ag (Adr) (NYSE:NVS) by 7,457 shares in the quarter, for a total of 9.46 million shares, and has risen its stake in Fiserv Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV).
